notes: «حدثنا بذلك، علي بن حجر» is a second isnad for the same saying («نحوه»), so it is a second group.
The report then gives a second saying, Umm Habiba's, through Abu Zur'a's remark («عن مكحول عن عنبسة بن أبي سفيان عن أم حبيبة») with its own isnad: needs_ruling, not read here.
The remarks on the chapter, on the schools' views, and on Makhul's hearing are not routes.
